### Replay eight merged Java changes through their public callers

[`6073133ec08f`](https://github.com/pilifs/in-the-loop/commit/6073133ec08fb31c4f64767e5863ab3d048adb36) · [log `736d30c0a720`](https://terminalvalue.net/raw-traces/01a213e1-2aba-74b0-8209-fee0282af970/736d30c0a720be0c39b7a2a23a4db6b9f0bb05f8a95a111ce27959dcb714b5bd.jsonl.gz)

Register the first 24 L-series questions on the two source pins, with fresh JVMs, checked class providers and both Arrow allocators. Picocli loses its primary command after alias clearing, both JGraphT algorithms return an edge object absent from the input graph, and Commons Statistics overflows a finite scaled tail. JUnit independently reselected both same-named test bodies.

All eight normal validators reproduced 54 observations across nine deployment pairs. All 54 selected suites passed for this slice, including the 22 packet checks repeated against its router. The wider integration continues with the other twelve cases.

### Complete 20 merged Java comparisons (verification pending)

[`9fdc9c7a731d`](https://github.com/pilifs/in-the-loop/commit/9fdc9c7a731d5289bc691631b1845e5f7f0f8ce3) · [log `eb17786fb0c3`](https://terminalvalue.net/raw-traces/01a213e1-2aba-74b0-8209-fee0282af970/eb17786fb0c374830824b9f1fb9881359b129d42e09815910445f65c29604be1.jsonl.gz)

Add the remaining twelve public callers and audit every one of the sixty predictions across twenty-three deployment pairs. All twenty controls held. Nineteen full intent predictions and fifty-five merged predictions matched. Three upstream defects carry runnable release and development reproductions. PostgreSQL 16.16 independently identified the JSqlParser challenge's invalid CASCADE assumption.

Recover the original grolifant JAR whose SHA-256 Gradle pins on both sides, and resolve it with both original strict verification policies. The Gradle fixtures now exercise both exact named-action methods and both public distributions. Rebuild the omitted Kafka test driver from each pin, execute real Maven shading and ServiceLoader discovery, inspect both Quartz tables and scheduler state on Derby and PostgreSQL, and exercise a Parquet equality delete.

All twenty examples passed normal replay validation, including the final Gradle and Kafka inputs. The completed change passed all 56 selected suites. The 136 historical JVM observations, 18 release and development histories, six released Gradle histories and the independent SQL grammar check reproduced. Four debugger trials qualified the original JGraphT method. Negative controls and the previous campaign's audit passed.

The independent public matrix, upstream and database repeat, and three original methods are jobs 20261125-183811-replay-60-l-series-java-questions-on-23, 20261125-183812-repeat-three-l-series-upstream-defects-a and 20261125-183812-qualify-l-series-alias-graph-and-probabi. Job 20261125-184502-build-both-complete-gradle-pins-with-the builds both full Gradle distributions under strict verification and compares all six histories.
